title: Compact precision field log — July 12 2027
content:
Purpose and context:
This is a lightweight weekly field log capturing ad-hoc experiments, standup captures, and a short onboarding checklist for the new compact precision candidate (codenamed compact-p). Focus areas this week: offline PTQ probes, eval set regressions, and KV-cache interaction tests under continuous batching. Intention: capture quick wins, open questions, and concrete next steps for the onboarding wiki entry.

High-level summary (top-line):
- PTQ (per-layer symmetric int8) gives ~2.1x throughput improvement on rw-7b-like variants on A100 while maintaining ~0.6–1.4% task metric degradation depending on task.
- One failure mode observed: prefix continuation gets <0.5% lower exact-match when KV-cache is warmed across mixed-precision calls (FP16 then INT8). Root cause likely mismatch in cache serialization/scale-factors.
- Evaluation harness flagged a hallucination spike on summarization dev set (ROUGE-L down 3.2 pts) for sequence length > 1k tokens — appears correlated with attention kernel switching at >1024.

Standup notes (Jul 12):
- Priya: ran batch of PTQ runs for 7b candidate (config list below). Found consistent latency wins but one jittery run when autoscaler spun up an extra worker — need to repeat with pinned worker set. Blocker: access to one of the 8-bit quant kernels on older runtime images.
- Marco: ported a small eval harness to produce token-level divergence traces (token diffs over reference). Shared tool: tools/dev/token-diff.py in PR. Next: add inline alignment metrics.
- Li: reproduced KV-cache mismatch locally; traced serialization to micro-diff in scale metadata -> quantized cache write path. Will propose a compatibility shim for mixed-precision sessions.
- Samir: investigated hallucination spike; hypothesis: attention kernel fallback to slower generic kernel changes numerical path. Will run with forced kernel selection to confirm.

Experiments run (concise table):
- Model: compact-p-7b (FP16 baseline) / compact-p-7b-ptq (layerwise symmetric int8, per-channel weight scaling)
- Workload: summarization-dev, long-context Q&A, code-completion short prompts

CSV-style results (metric, baseline, ptq, delta):
ROUGE-L (summ-dev, <512): 41.6, 41.1, -0.5
ROUGE-L (summ-dev, 512-1024): 39.2, 37.9, -1.3
ROUGE-L (summ-dev, 1024-2048): 36.7, 33.5, -3.2  <-- investigation focus
Exact-match (QA short): 78.3, 77.9, -0.4
Perplexity (wikitext-mini): 12.1, 12.9, +0.8
Tail latency p95 (A100, batch=1): 230ms, 110ms, -120ms
Throughput (tokens/s, batch=8): 310, 660, +112%

Quick interpretations:
- Small metric drops for short-context tasks are within our regression budget for cost-first tiers, but long-context summarization regression is problematic.
- The large throughput wins make PTQ attractive for Dedicated customers; need to triage the long-context regression before recommending.

Repro configs (notes to self):
- PTQ tool: tools/quant/ptq-lite v0.3 (seed 42)
- Calibration set: 2k random summarization samples (seeded split)
- Runtime image: rw-runtime:2027-06-30 (issue with legacy kernels)
- Batch policy: continuous-batch, max-latency-slo 350ms

Debug traces and hypotheses:
1) KV-cache scale metadata: Li found that quantized cache stores a per-tensor scale in little-endian float32. When mixed-precision pipeline writes with a different rounding path, subsequent reads apply slightly different dequant multiplies leading to token errors at generation boundary. Possible fix: canonicalize cache scale to quantized integer scale + int exponent or attach versioned checksum.
2) Attention-kernel fallback: For seq>1024, kernels switch to a generic fallback that uses a different matmul tiling and accum precision. This appears to correlate with ROUGE-L drop. Experiment: force use of 'opt-v2' kernel at >1024 and see if metric recovers.
3) Calibration sample bias: our calibration sampling had many short-document samples; rerun with more long-context samples.

Model onboarding checklist (for compact-p candidate) — minimal viable rollout:
- [ ] Smoke profile (latency, throughput) across cpu/gpu/hybrid instances (done: basic)
- [ ] Stability: run 72h continuous generation at various concurrency levels (in progress)
- [ ] KV-cache compatibility tests: mixed precision write/read coverage (failing)
- [ ] Eval suite: short QA, summarization long & short, code-completion, toxicity quick-check (some runs complete)
- [ ] Regression gates: predefined deltas per task (set thresholds; need owners to sign off)
- [ ] Rollout plan: canary on Dedicated pool -> A/B with fallback to fp16 -> promotions
- [ ] Docs: runtime flags exposed, recommended batch configs, quant caveats (todo: draft)

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Decision: allow PTQ-backed models in Hosted low-tier (cost-sensitive) while long-context issues remain? Recommend enabling only for Dedicated and Private for now.
- Who signs off on regression thresholds for summarization long-context? Ping: Product-Hosted-API and Evaluation owners.
- Do we add a runtime compatibility shim for KV-cache or prefer to require cache flush on mixed-precision calls? Velocity vs correctness tradeoff.

Next actions (this week):
- Priya: reproduce PTQ runs with pinned workers and new runtime image (due Jul 14). Create a minimal reproducer for long-context drop.
- Li: prototype cache scale shim and run regression (due Jul 15).
- Marco: run forced-kernel experiments (opt-v2) and post traces (due Jul 14).
- Samir: extend eval harness to include token-diff visualization and annotate top-10 divergent examples (due Jul 16).

Notes-to-self / rough ideas:
- Consider storing quant cache metadata as (quant_scale_int16, exponent8) to avoid float32 endianness issues in cross-language clients.
- Add a nightly job that runs long-context summarization with mixed-precision switches to catch regressions early.
- Slack shorthand: use #applied-ml for quick syncs; add triage-label on JIRA for PTQ-long-context.

Appendix: useful refs and commands:
- Repro command (local): ./tools/quant/run_ptq.sh --model compact-p-7b --calib samples/2k.jsonl --out out/ptq-7b-seed42 --runtime rw-runtime:2027-06-30
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/3421 (kernel selector flags)
- JIRA: JIRA-ML-1287 (PTQ long-context regression)

End of note.

(Informal: this is a working capture — will clean up and move stable items into the applied-ml onboarding wiki once we have reproducer and shim.)
